acceptance_conditions: resume-model builds the Gold resume model only from BORA_APPROVED_RESUME_LANGUAGE_V1 by id and the approved identity: work Winter Walk B010/B012/B013/B014, TELUS Digital B008/B009, D Commerce Bank B001/B002 newest first; project MARKETMIND (B003-B007, summary S002|S003) or MARKET_EMPIRE (B019-B023, summary S002, MarketMind recorded as NOT_RELEVANT_PER_CROSSWALK); fixed skills rows; never B011, B015, B016 (Bulmarma) or S005.

resume-model loads the runtime exactly as package does (career_os_cloud_operate_v1.make_cloud_operate_deps), builds the DOCX with the canonical builder and runs the canonical pre_render_qa; it writes model.json and prints READY only if both pass, otherwise RESUME_MODEL_LAYOUT_* or RESUME_MODEL_QA_FAILED with each failed check.
package --resume-model replaces the request resume_model and refuses a model whose job_id differs (RESUME_MODEL_JOB_MISMATCH); without the flag package behaves as before.
Package failures carrying a QA report append each failed check and its detail (bounded) after the existing detail.
